name: TrailingStopAndTake
summary: This EA is a trailing stop and take profit management utility that does not open its own positions. It monitors existing open positions and dynamically adjusts their stop loss levels to trail price movement, while also managing take profit targets based on user-configurable parameters.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个移动止损和止盈管理工具，不会自行开仓。它监控已有的持仓，根据价格变动动态调整止损水平以跟踪利润，同时根据用户配置的参数管理止盈目标。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不是一个自主交易策略，而是一个持仓管理工具。它不产生任何入场信号或自行开仓，仅对已存在的持仓进行管理。其核心功能是移动止损（Trailing Stop），即随着价格朝有利方向移动，逐步将止损价位向盈利方向推移以锁定利润。同时具备止盈管理功能，可以设置固定或动态的止盈目标。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅对现有持仓的止损和止盈进行修改。资金管理方面，通过移动止损来保护已有利润，间接起到资金保护作用。该工具适用于所有已有持仓的策略，作为辅助工具提升风控能力。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an autonomous trading strategy but rather a position management utility. It does not generate any entry signals or open positions on its own; it only manages existing open positions. Its core functionality is trailing stop, which means as price moves favorably, it gradually shifts the stop loss level in the profitable direction to lock in gains. It also features take profit management, allowing users to set fixed or dynamic take profit targets. In terms of position sizing, the EA does not handle lot size calculation since it never opens trades. For money management, it indirectly protects capital by using trailing stops to secure unrealized profits. This tool is applicable to any strategy with existing positions, serving as an auxiliary tool to enhance risk control capabilities.

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，当价格达到此距离后开始追踪
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop points; activates when price reaches this distance

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 移动止损步长，每次调整止损的最小移动点数
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop step; minimum points for each stop adjustment

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设置止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术编号，0表示管理所有持仓

parameters.name: UseTrailingStop
parameters.description: 是否启用移动止损功能

pros: 有效保护已有利润，降低回撤风险
可灵活配置止损距离和步长参数
兼容任何已有持仓的策略，通用性强
pros_en: Effectively protects unrealized profits and reduces drawdown risk
Flexible configuration of trailing distance and step parameters
Compatible with any existing position strategy, strong versatility
cons: 不产生交易信号，完全依赖其他策略或手动开仓
在剧烈波动市场中可能因止损过近而被扫出
缺乏对点差和市场流动性的考虑，可能在滑点较大时表现不佳
cons_en: Does not generate trading signals, entirely dependent on other strategies or manual entry
May get stopped out prematurely in highly volatile markets due to tight trailing distance
Lacks consideration for spread and market liquidity, may underperform during significant slippage
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态移动止损，适应市场波动性变化
添加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在高点差时段调整止损
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic trailing stop to adapt to changing market volatility
Add spread filter and trading session control to avoid adjusting stops during high-spread periods

risk_points: 移动止损参数设置不当可能导致频繁被扫止损
不检查市场冻结状态可能导致止损修改失败
risk_points_en: Improper trailing stop parameters may lead to frequent stop-outs
Not checking market freeze status may cause stop loss modification failures

summary_en: This EA is a trailing stop and take profit management utility that does not open its own positions. It monitors existing open positions and dynamically adjusts their stop loss levels to trail price movement, while also managing take profit targets based on user-configurable parameters.
